sub_branches.label: Acute Disseminated Encephalomyelitis
sub_branches.why_included: The patient's symptoms of progressive apathy, unresponsiveness, and immobility, along with the presence of a hypodense lesion in the corpus callosum on brain CT and a homogeneous mass in the corpus callosum body on MRI, are consistent with Acute Disseminated Encephalomyelitis (ADEM). ADEM is a rare autoimmune disease characterized by a sudden, widespread attack of inflammation in the brain and spinal cord, which can lead to damage of the myelin sheath surrounding nerve fibers.

sub_branches.label: Multiple Sclerosis
sub_branches.why_included: The patient's symptoms of progressive apathy, unresponsiveness, and immobility, along with the presence of a hypodense lesion in the corpus callosum on brain CT and a homogeneous mass in the corpus callosum body on MRI, are also consistent with Multiple Sclerosis (MS). MS is a chronic autoimmune disease that affects the central nervous system, leading to damage of the myelin sheath surrounding nerve fibers.
